design.evaluation: leave-one-task-family-out over 4 families; all label-dependent parameters fitted on the other 3 families
design.invalid_position_rule: predicted step >= len(trace) is clamped to len(trace)-1; predicted step < 0 is clamped to 0
design.tie_break: most frequent; ties broken by string order (deterministic)
design.posthoc_const_step3: retrospective diagnostic using the labels themselves; not a leakage-controlled baseline
